_comment: Christmas collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. Requested by name: Snorlax line as Santa Claus, Turtwig line as Christmas trees, Trubbish line as Christmas gifts, Phantump line as Krampus. The other 14 were picked with `generate.py pick --count 14 --seed christmas-2026` (random lines no other collection uses).

readme.title: Christmas
readme.summary: Christmas costumes for four lines and a Festive look for the rest.
looks: Festive: a Christmas palette (crimson, gold, pine, icy blue, berry), snow settled on top, snowflakes
strings of fairy lights that glow in the dark and twinkle
shiny: Frosted, in silver, ice and snow

specials.look: Santa Claus: red suit with white fur trim, black belt with a gold buckle, white beard
specials.shiny: an old-world Father Christmas in green

specials.look: Christmas tree: pine needles, baubles, gold tinsel, twinkling fairy lights and snow
Christmas gift: candy-stripe wrapping paper, a green satin ribbon, a bow and a gift tag
specials.shiny: gold foil with a red ribbon

specials.look: Krampus: shaggy black goat fur, ram's horns, red eyes that glow in the dark, iron chains with gold bells
